findings.comment: Both lots: missing surveyed floor/spot/garage elevations and engineered proposed grading. See READINESS.md R01.
Unsigned professional certification; designer/checker and owner details incomplete. Do not change PRELIMINARY until reviewed.
Sanitary paths visibly exit public easement shading. Reconcile continuity and all service routes with approved WSSC design.
Private easement extends beyond page-2 reference segment; 10-foot width is an assumption in source JSON. Obtain legal instrument before redrawing.
ESD footprint and summary Q/WQv are insufficient: provide approved concept, calculations, facility sections, elevations, outlets and overflow.
16,789 SF AT LEAST is not a final coordinated disturbance calculation. Provide labelled LOD and erosion/sediment-control plan.
Woodland/floodplain NOT ESTABLISHED. Soils, groundwater, TCP2/exemption and landscape evidence outstanding.
20-foot rear yard shown as provided conflicts with Lot 2 side-yard assumption. Verify zoning; show per-lot setbacks and coverage.
Use recorded lot areas 9,598 / 8,008 SF; gross 21,825; net 17,606. Distinguish computed geometry from recorded values.
Recorded driveway condition truncated with ellipsis. Full condition requires abutting driveway design unless separate aprons deemed appropriate by DPW&T.
3-foot public sidewalk needs standards/approval verification. Aprons visually meet curb; grades/approval remain unverified.
Only one Kingsworth foundation/basement sheet found. Resolve basement/areaway/garage options and supply full project-specific building set.
Supporting application records and current approvals not established. See READINESS.md R13.
